mentions.name: folio.photo
mentions.description: A photography portfolio platform that doubles as client gallery delivery, offering white labelling, password protection, and other features not available on average file sharing platforms. The author hosts a personal gallery with it.
mentions.problem: Average file sharing platforms lack portfolio-focused features like white labelling and client gallery delivery.
